description:
Offline rich-text notes with fonts, media and no cloud

All the notes, none of the cloud.

Nocean is a small, fast, fully offline rich-text notes app. Your notes and media stay in the app's private storage. The app doesn't even request the Internet permission.

Features

  • Rich text: H1, H2 and H3 headings, bold, italic, and a font per text range
  • Fonts, offline: Inter, Lora, Playfair Display, DM Serif Display, Nunito, Oswald, Caveat and Geist Mono ship inside the app. No network or Play Services needed
  • Inline media: insert images, videos and audio. Tap one to open a full-screen viewer with pinch-zoom, or a player
  • Zip backup: export every note and its media to one .zip and restore it on any device. On import, a note replaces an existing one only if it's newer
  • Share: send a note's text to any app, or share text into Nocean to save it as a new note
  • Note info: word, character and paragraph counts, media totals, and created/edited dates
  • Three themes: Ocean, Pepper and Cherry, with a frosted-glass look (real blur on Android 12+)
